services.desc: Come join us as we cruise the Waikiki coastline 2 Hours About Hop on our zodiac boat and soak up Waikiki's stunning coastline. Our small vessel ensures quick travel, giving you plenty of time for fun and relaxation. With fewer passengers, you'll enjoy more space and comfort. Dive in for an unforgettable snorkeling experience with Pacific Hawaiian fish and majestic sea turtles. Keep reading for everything you need to know for your adventure with Diamond Head Cruises and Adventures.
